title: Beyond Unit Tests: Path-Aware Rubric-Guided LLM Autograding of Notebooks
abstract: arXiv:2611.28565v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Jupyter notebooks support open-ended, multi-step assessments in which students build one logical flow across interdependent steps, combining code, written analysis, and generated outputs such as plots. These reflect authentic scientific practice but are hard to grade consistently, since students may make different yet equally valid choices at each step, so a later answer can only be judged in light of the choices a student made earlier. We present an LLM-based autograder for such flow-structured notebook questions. It generates a rubric from a reference solution, then applies a softening pass that relaxes criteria tied to the reference so legitimate alternative paths are not penalized. Each question group is graded in a single model call, so later answers are judged against the student's own earlier choices, using question-type tags and schema-constrained, low-temperature outputs. translated_title: 超越单元测试：路径感知、评分细则引导的 LLM 笔记本自动评分
translated_abstract: Jupyter 笔记本支持开放式、多步骤的评估，学生在其中跨相互依赖的步骤构建一个统一的逻辑流程，将代码、书面分析以及图表等生成的输出结合在一起。这类作业反映了真实的科学实践，但难以进行一致的评分，因为学生在每一步可能做出不同却同样有效的选择，因此后面的答案只能结合学生之前所做的选择来评判。我们提出了一种针对此类流程结构化笔记本问题的基于 LLM 的自动评分器。它首先从参考解答生成评分细则，然后应用一个“软化”步骤，放宽与参考解答绑定的标准，使合理的替代解题路径不会受到惩罚。每个问题组通过单次模型调用完成评分，从而后续答案能够对照学生自己先前的选择来评判，同时使用问题类型标签以及模式约束、低温度的输出。证据以多模态方式进行评分：代码、文本、数值输出……
tldr: 该论文提出一种路径感知、评分细则引导的 LLM 自动评分器，通过软化评分细则以容忍合理的替代解题路径，并在单次模型调用中结合学生自身先前选择进行多模态评分，实现对流程式 Jupyter 笔记本作业的一致且可靠的自动评分。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a path-aware, rubric-guided LLM autograder that softens reference-based criteria to credit legitimate alternative solution paths and grades each question group in a single model call, enabling consistent, multimodal autograding of flow-structured Jupyter notebook assessments.
